$comment: Everything template code may import. Mirrors the platform's TEMPLATE_REPO_DEP_ALLOWLIST — the set of packages a Mosaic host resolves for external repos (sharp and @twemoji/svg were dropped upstream on 2026-09-16; anything else compiles here and fails at host load). Enforced by tools/check-deps.mjs (pure Node, no install needed). Per-file exceptions carry a reason.

exceptions.reason: Build-time generator, not template code — reads preview assets and writes template-manifest.json.
Probes for the baked robot-M mark (assets/one-a-day-m.png) at module load; absent → the brand M. Same pattern as the official community front door.
